quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 1,065,881,192.39, up 38.89% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 20,145,995.69, down 62.06%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -6,806,650.08 (2024: RMB 26,160,297.83); operating cash flow RMB -187,347,968.19. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 240,098,237.36, Q2 RMB 289,401,012.66, Q3 RMB 269,330,840.91, Q4 RMB 267,051,101.46. The company attributes the profit decline to higher R&D expense, higher finance costs and higher credit impairment as receivables rose with solar-grade germanium sales; overall gross margin 21.12%, down 7.36 points, as unit costs rose faster than prices for most germanium products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Revenue by product (annual report, 2025): compound semiconductor materials (gallium arsenide and indium phosphide wafers) RMB 137,852,981.01, up 63.00%, gross margin 23.33%, up 12.24 points; fiber-grade germanium (germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber) RMB 199,856,330.23, up 127.76%, gross margin 17.84%; solar-grade germanium RMB 197,233,330.95, up 86.80%, gross margin 32.55%; material-grade germanium RMB 363,605,186.31, up 2.76%, gross margin 4.32%; infrared-grade germanium RMB 121,087,322.36, up 4.89%. By industry, compound semiconductors RMB 147,312,094.76, up 74.18%, gross margin 24.10%. Overseas revenue fell 63.38% to RMB 49,524,127.55 (4.65% of revenue); domestic revenue RMB 1,016,357,064.84, up 60.77%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Output and sales volume (annual report, 2025): the company produced 10.01 ten-thousand InP wafers (2-4 inch) and 7.63 ten-thousand GaAs wafers (1-6 inch); compound-semiconductor sales volume was 153,879.81 wafers (4-inch equivalent), up 41.86% - InP volume (4-inch equivalent) up 73.77% and GaAs up 33.18% on higher downstream data-center and optical-communication demand; InP wafer sales grew sharply and the customer count kept rising. Compound-semiconductor average prices rose while unit cost fell slightly on higher output. Fiber-grade germanium sales volume 36,035.20 kg, up 49.50%, on fiber demand driven by AI computing build-out and data-center expansion; solar germanium wafer sales 836,700.75 (4-inch equivalent), up 75.04%, on low-earth-orbit satellite constellation deployment.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D investment RMB 119,781,564.42, up 79.71%, 11.24% of revenue, of which RMB 39,377,592.16 capitalised; R&D staff 153 (2024: 106). An InP wafer intelligent-manufacturing project built a demonstration production line that passed acceptance; a VGF-InP single-crystal defect-suppression project is running thermal-field simulation and crystal-growth validation; 3-inch indium antimonide (InSb) wafer processing has been developed and 4-inch polishing and cleaning is in development; large-size InP and GaAs new products are under development.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 production plan (annual report, company targets): InP wafers 18 ten-thousand (2-6 inch, mainly 3-4 inch); GaAs wafers 8 ten-thousand (3-6 inch); fiber-grade germanium 35 tonnes; solar germanium wafers 145 ten-thousand (4-6 inch); material-grade germanium 73 tonnes (including internal sales and toll processing); infrared lenses and optical systems 8000 sets. The company plans to raise the sales share of large-size InP wafers, RF GaAs wafers, solar germanium wafers and compound optical systems, aiming at AI computing, optical communications and space photovoltaics, and to push key projects including the high-quality InP wafer project and the high-quality GaAs wafer project.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Construction in progress (annual report): CIP RMB 97,985,827.52 at end-2025 (start of year RMB 65,297,514.41), mainly the space solar-cell germanium wafer project (budget RMB 291,450,000.00; RMB 31,931,999.58 invested, 10.96% complete); the high-quality GaAs wafer project had RMB 14,485,966.67 invested (5.32% progress) and the advanced germanium materials project 1.00%; all under construction and not yet at capacity.
